name: codex-window-opacity
description: Adjust and persist the opacity of the Codex desktop window on Windows.

interface.shortDescription: Show your wallpaper through the Codex desktop window.
interface.longDescription: A Windows-only Codex plugin that adjusts, saves, reapplies, and restores whole-window opacity without modifying Codex application files.
defaultPrompt: Set the Codex window to 90% opacity.
Make the Codex window more transparent.
Restore the Codex window to fully opaque.
